description:
About the role: 

Our team is at the heart of our success. You’ll be part of a culture where everyone is respected, included, and encouraged to grow. We value continuous learning, uphold a high work ethic, and have fun along the way.

As a Senior iOS Developer, you’ll work on the Printful and Printify iOS apps, which merchants use to design products, manage their stores, and track orders. Both apps are built with SwiftUI and The Composable Architecture (TCA). You’ll help shape feature design and architecture, set technical direction with the team, and make decisions that affect thousands of users worldwide. You’ll work closely with designers, backend developers, and our Android team to deliver consistent, polished experiences across platforms.

Your daily tasks will include:

  • Designing, building, and maintaining features in modular SwiftUI apps

  • Owning features end to end, from design review and architecture to A/B testing and release

  • Driving architectural decisions and raising the bar on code quality through code reviews

  • Mentoring other developers and sharing best practices across the mobile team

  • Improving app performance, stability, and crash-free rate

  • Keeping up with Apple platforms, including new iOS releases and Swift language changes, and bringing what’s useful into our apps

Your qualifications:

  • 5+ years of professional experience building production iOS apps in Swift

  • Strong experience with SwiftUI

  • Solid understanding of Swift concurrency (async/await, actors, Sendable)

  • Experience with modular app architecture and Swift Package Manager

  • Experience writing unit tests (XCTest or Swift Testing)

  • A track record of making architectural decisions and leading features from idea to release

  • Experience working with Git, code review, and collaborative development

  • Good knowledge of Apple’s Human Interface Guidelines


Nice to have:

  • Experience with The Composable Architecture (TCA) or another unidirectional architecture (Redux/MVI-style)

  • UIKit interoperability

  • WidgetKit or other app extensions

  • CI/CD for iOS (GitHub Actions, TestFlight, App Store release process)

  • Product analytics and experimentation (Amplitude, Firebase)

  • Crash reporting and triage (Sentry, Crashlytics)

  • Snapshot testing

  • Experience working with AI-assisted development tools

What we offer:

  • Monthly salary starting from EUR 4,000 gross, depending on your work experience, education, and skills

  • A global, inclusive team that’s as supportive as it is ambitious and serious about getting things done

  • An opportunity to work remotely or in a modern and welcoming office in Riga

  • Flexible working hours (start your day as late as 11 AM)

  • Private health insurance

  • 2 extra paid days off to focus on your mental or physical well-being

  • 1 extra paid day off to celebrate a Birthday or any other celebration of your choice

  • Internal and external learning opportunities

  • Access to mentorship, internal meetups, and hackathons, both on-site and online

  • Free and healthy lunch if you work from the Rīga office

  • Design and order your own merch using our platforms with an employee discount

  • Exciting team-building events and parties you’ll never forget!


FYUL is the engine that powers on-demand commerce at global scale.

Formed in 2024 through the merger of Printful, Printify, and Snow Commerce, we bring together tech, talent, and infrastructure to help people turn ideas into beautiful products.

From solo creators to entertainment giants, FYUL powers merch that connects with millions, backed by advanced tech, premium production, and global reach.

We're a fast-growing global company working toward powering great brands, great experiences, and great people.

We are an equal-opportunity workplace. We’re committed to diversity and inclusion and make hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and work experience.

If you think you’d excel in this role, send us your resume in English, showing us why you are the right person for the job.

Interested, but don’t think this is the right fit for you? Feel free to share it with friends and check out other open positions at our career site. We’re always looking for creative and driven minds to join our ever-growing team!

AS Printful Latvia (Reģ. Nr. 40203050078)
